text: Soprema is an independent family group since its creation in 1908; operating company Soprema SAS (Strasbourg, SIREN 314527557) is led by Crigel GmbH as président, and Holding Soprema SA — the group holding — is led by Pierre-Étienne Bindschedler.
short: Soprema is an independent family group since 1908; no state or fund shareholder identified.
